summary: Index international caller-report services and reuse routes
description: Publish a machine-readable, dated discovery index of consumer who-called services, their jurisdictions, report/status capabilities, API or feed options, robots and terms references, reuse posture, and activation gap without copying number records.
acceptance: A dated machine-readable index covers every service found by the documented NL and international discovery queries, including service URL, jurisdictions, report/status capability, API/feed availability, terms/robots references, reuse decision, and next activation action.
The index contains no report text or phone-number records and cannot mark a source ingestible from public visibility or robots alone.
Schema, documentation, task graph, and rights tests remain consistent and public-safe.

review_history.evidence: Approved against the finished task: the dated index covers 15 Dutch and international caller-report services discovered through documented queries; every entry records capabilities, robots, terms or no-terms finding, reuse status, blocking gates, and next action; schema prohibits disabled sources from carrying permitted fields and prohibits enablement without documented rights; no number records or report content are stored; 206 Python tests, 8 web tests, Go validation, docs, assets, and public-safety gates passed.
